title: Building key-value pairs
description: You can create dictionaries one pair at a time or with an initial collection of pairs.

steps.description: The curly braces create an empty dictionary. You add Taylor as a key with the phone number string 555-1234 as its value.

steps.question: Does adding Jordan replace Taylor's entry?
steps.answer: No. Jordan is a different key, so phonebook keeps both pairs.

steps.description: You see both names and their phone numbers in the printed dictionary. Square brackets identify the key used by each assignment.
menu creates three pairs inside its braces, using a colon between each key and value. You see coffee mapped to 3, bagel to 2 and muffin to 4.
